description: This Kotlin class 'CardPresenter' is a custom presenter for displaying media items as cards in an Android TV application. It creates image views, handles selection animations, binds media item data including images and content descriptions, and manages view cleanup.

classes.name: CardPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class that displays media items as image cards with focus animations and content descriptions for Android TV.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and returns a ViewHolder containing an image view configured for focus and size.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds a MediaItem to the view, loading its image and setting content description.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears Glide image loading and resets view properties for recycling.
